key_objectives: Shift visual tone from generic 'AI blue' to an authoritative, professional fleet management industry leader
Introduce a warm, high-contrast, editorial visual hierarchy with generous white space and clean typography
Relocate the large Live Fleet Status dashboard window into the Features section tabs
Organize features and pricing with clear, prominent subheadings
Remove cookie consent notices completely from the public landing experience
Preserve 100% of existing copy, client logos, HCCI award assets, video, ROI calculator logic, contact form backend, and data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not modify backend code or route definitions.
2. Update `/app/frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.js` to implement the new 'Premium and Understated' design blueprint.

3. Replace the old bright blue CSS variables with warm stone/off-white backgrounds (--bg: #FBFBF9), rich charcoal text (--ink: #0F172A), dark slate containers (--navy: #0F172A, --navy-2: #1E293B), and refined cobalt blue accent (#1E40AF).
4. In the Hero section, remove the massive full-width Live Fleet Status dashboard window and place it inside Tab 01 of the Features section.
5. Ensure subheadings are present in both the Features section and Pricing cards to clearly explain features and pricing tiers.
6. Completely remove any Cookie Notice or Cookie Consent banner from the landing page as requested by user.
7. Preserve all existing event delegation logic (onClick, onInput, onSubmit) and exact data-testid attributes so automated test suites pass without regression.
8. Keep exact contact form submission API logic (`/api/public/contact`), ROI calculation formula, image URLs, and text content.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
